Teilnehmen or Besuchen? German B1 Attendance Practice

Compare an einem Kurs teilnehmen with einen Kurs besuchen. Practise attendance meaning together with each verb’s preposition and case.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Teilnehmen an + dative means participating in an event or activity. Besuchen can mean attending a course or visiting a person/place, and takes an accusative object without an before it. Both can describe attending a course, but their sentence structures differ.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not mix the patterns: an einem Seminar teilnehmen, but ein Seminar besuchen. Neither verb alone proves whether an attendee actively speaks.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Wir nehmen an einem Fotoworkshop teil.We take part in a photography workshop.
Worked example 2Sie besucht einen Abendkurs in Geschichte.She attends an evening class in history.
Worked example 3An der Abstimmung nehmen alle Mitglieder teil.All members take part in the vote.
Worked example 4Am Sonntag besuchen wir unsere früheren Nachbarn.On Sunday we visit our former neighbours.

Practice: choose the right word

Use the verb fitting the supplied structure. Where teil is supplied, fill only the finite stem of teilnehmen. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Er ___ an einem Onlinegespräch teil. (teilnehmen)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: nimmt

Teilnehmen selects an + dative and separates into nimmt ... teil.

Question 2. Wir ___ einen Kurs an der Volkshochschule. (besuchen)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: besuchen

The supplied accusative object has no an, matching besuchen.

Question 3. Möchtest du an der Diskussion ___? (take part)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: teilnehmen

The infinitive teilnehmen follows möchtest.

Question 4. Sie möchte ihre Tante ___. (visit)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: besuchen

Visiting a person uses besuchen with an accusative object.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
